{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Compute number of valid age entries
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)

# Print both numbers
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {num_valid_ages}")"}
